title: What We Know Now About True Benefits and Dangers of mRNA COVID Vaccines, with Dr. Aseem Malhotra
flagged_phrase: more than 70% of people that died within a couple of weeks of having the vaccine almost certainly caused by the vaccine that's been proven ... it's at least eight times more harmful to have the COVID vaccine in the highest risk group than to have benefit
supporting_evidence: The '70% of deaths caused by the vaccine' figure comes from a small autopsy case-series review (Hulscher et al.) that selected cases already suspected of vaccine involvement — a selected denominator cannot yield a population causal fraction, and that paper was itself withdrawn by its preprint host. The Fraiman et al. (2022, Vaccine) reanalysis reported ~1 per 800 serious adverse events of special interest but used a composite endpoint including events with no established causal link, and its authors did not conclude net harm; subsequent large linked-record studies found no such rate (IN CORPUS: vaccines-11-01118.pdf, ~5.1M people; vaccines-09-00467-v2.pdf RCT meta-analysis, 235 cites). No increase in cancer incidence after COVID-19 vaccination has been demonstrated in population data. Excess cardiac events since 2021 are attributed principally to COVID-19 infection itself and to disrupted care, and vaccinated cohorts show LOWER non-COVID mortality (Xu et al. 2023, JAMA Netw Open). Vitamin C does not clear spike protein.
annotator_note: Megyn Kelly with Dr Aseem Malhotra. A sequence of specific statistical claims asserted as established: (1) 'more than 70% of people that died within a couple of weeks of having the vaccine almost certainly caused by the vaccine — that's been proven'; (2) serious adverse event rate 'at least one in 800 at two months' from the Fraiman/Doshi reanalysis, which he says 'has not been rebutted'; (3) that it is therefore 'at least eight times more harmful to have the COVID vaccine in the highest risk group than to have benefit'; (4) that the vaccines were 'a likely contributory factor in all unexpected cardiac arrests, heart attacks, strokes, cardiac arrhythmias and heart failures since 2021'; (5) that the vaccines accelerate heart disease and increase cancer via immunosuppression. Advises vitamin C and lifestyle to 'mitigate' it. Followed by a Birch Gold advertisement. Note he is correct that the Fraiman reanalysis exists and reported an elevated serious-AE signal — the falsehood is treating it as settled and extrapolating a net-harm conclusion from it.

supporting_evidence: Hybrid immunity (infection plus vaccination) is consistently the most protective state; infection-acquired immunity alone is more variable, depends on initial severity, and carries the risk of the infection itself (IN CORPUS: vaccines-11-01693.pdf; s41598-023-47043.pdf; s41541-022-00594-7.pdf — the natural_immunity topic exists precisely for this narrative). Already in chunk_eval_labels territory as natural_immunity.
annotator_note: Project Veritas-style undercover edit of three Pfizer employees. The video's ASSERTED THESIS — conveyed by title ('Pfizer Scientist tell the Truth'), narration, and selective arrangement — is that Pfizer scientists privately know natural immunity is superior and that mandates exist for profit rather than evidence. Two distinct problems: (1) the central scientific claim, that infection-acquired immunity is 'probably more' protective and lasts longer than vaccination, is stated as settled by junior staff speaking casually and is not supported; (2) the format is itself unreliable — secretly recorded, heavily cut, with identical quotes repeated several times in different order, so no quote can be read as a considered position. Note that some individual remarks are NOT false: that antibodies wane, that efficacy dropped from ~95% to ~70% against Delta, and that Pfizer earned large COVID revenues are all accurate; and the myocarditis-testing remark describes legitimate pharmacovigilance. Confidence medium because the falsehood lies in the video's framing and editing rather than in a single fabricated statement.

Biodistribution beyond the deltoid is real but involves small quantities, chiefly to liver and spleen, and was in the regulatory dossier rather than concealed. The fibrinaloid-microclot hypothesis (Pretorius/Kell) concerns long COVID, is contested, and has not been established as a vaccine injury mechanism. Already in chunk_eval_labels as blood_clots.
annotator_note: HARDEST CASE IN THE DATASET. Senate testimony (Johnson hearing) by Dr Jordan Vaughn. Mixes verifiable citations with unsupported conclusions. TRUE elements: spike protein S1 does have pro-inflammatory and endothelial effects in vitro; the EMA Comirnaty assessment does report biodistribution beyond the injection site; the myocarditis signal did emerge in spring 2021 and was real; DOD cases were confirmed. UNSUPPORTED: that 10-15 million Americans are affected by long COVID or vaccine injury (conflates the two and far exceeds any estimate of vaccine injury); that mRNA causes 'uncontrolled production of the spike protein for an unknown duration'; that amyloid/fibrinaloid microclots seen on his own immunofluorescent microscopy establish vaccine causation; that autopsy findings have 'confirmed fatal vaccine-induced myocarditis' as an established category. Confidence medium because much of the testimony is defensible and the central claim is mechanistic speculation presented as established, rather than a fabricated statistic.

title: New flu mRNA vac, dangers
flagged_phrase: So 2.2% got serious side effects for a 0.8% reduction in absolute risk. Looks like a bit of a no-brainer to me ... We've seen that they're not really very safe and not particularly effective
supporting_evidence: Solicited grade 3 reactogenicity (injection-site pain, fever, fatigue limiting daily activity for 1-2 days) is categorically different from a serious adverse event and is not a harm comparable to influenza infection; conflating them inverts the risk-benefit calculation. Higher reactogenicity with mRNA platforms versus standard-dose inactivated comparators is well documented and expected from the stronger immune activation (IN CORPUS: vaccines-09-00467-v2.pdf RCT meta-analysis; vaccines-09-00989-v2.pdf phase-3 comparison; vaccines-11-01118.pdf real-world safety in ~5.1M people). Absolute risk reduction in a single season understates lifetime and population benefit, and the trial's stated endpoint was non-inferiority/superiority against an active comparator rather than against placebo. Isolated adverse events of special interest at 84 and 95 days post-vaccination, without rates or a control arm, cannot support a safety conclusion.
annotator_note: Dr John Campbell on the Moderna mRNA flu vaccine trial. DELIBERATE EDGE CASE and the most technically interesting in the dataset. Most figures are read accurately from the published paper, and the absolute-vs-relative-risk point is a legitimate critique. TWO FALSE ASSERTIONS: (1) ARITHMETIC ERROR USED AS THE CENTRAL ARGUMENT — he repeatedly compares '2.2% serious adverse events' and '6.4% grade 3 reactions' against a '0.8% absolute risk reduction' to conclude the vaccine is a 'no-brainer' to refuse. This is a category error: grade 3 solicited reactions are transient reactogenicity (a day or two of pain, fever, fatigue), not serious harm, and he conflates the two by juxtaposing them with the efficacy figure. He also states '6.4% versus 1%' is '6.4 times more', which is correct for that pair, but then treats reactogenicity frequency as commensurable with infection risk. (2) Asserts 'we've seen that they're not really very safe and not particularly effective' as a conclusion, and implies causal significance for two isolated adverse events of special interest (thrombocytopenia at 84 days, cardiomyopathy at 95 days) with no denominator or comparator. Confidence medium: he explicitly says 'not for me to tell you what to think' and sources everything to the paper, so a reviewer could label this false as aggressive-but-sourced commentary. FLAGGED FOR YOUR REVIEW.

title: The Problem With the COVID Vaccine | Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Explains to Theo Von
flagged_phrase: So what they're testing the vaccine for is not what we want to know. Does it prevent you from dying? ... And we will never know because they have geared back the studies ... it does not prevent transmission ... I become a super spreader like Typhoid Mary
supporting_evidence: The phase-3 trials measured severe COVID-19, hospitalisation and death as secondary endpoints, and efficacy against severe disease was demonstrated and published (IN CORPUS: vaccines-09-00467-v2.pdf RCT meta-analysis, 235 cites; vaccines-09-00989-v2.pdf phase-3 comparison). Real-world data on ~5.1M people confirmed protection against severe outcomes (IN CORPUS: vaccines-11-01118.pdf). Vaccination reduced onward transmission, with the largest effect against pre-Omicron variants; reduced viral load and shorter shedding duration were measured in household-contact studies. Placebo-arm crossover after demonstrated efficacy is standard research ethics, not evidence concealment, and long-term safety is tracked through post-authorisation surveillance rather than a maintained placebo arm. Already in chunk_eval_labels territory.
annotator_note: Theo Von with Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Accurately describes the event-driven trial design (22,000 per arm, stop at ~95-100 cases, 8-9:1 split giving ~90% efficacy) — that part is correct. The ASSERTED FALSEHOODS: (1) 'what they're testing the vaccine for is not what we want to know ... does it prevent you from dying? ... we will never know' — severe disease, hospitalisation and death were measured as secondary endpoints and reported; (2) that the vaccine 'does not prevent transmission' at all and makes recipients 'a super spreader like Typhoid Mary' — vaccination reduced transmission substantially, especially pre-Omicron, so asymptomatic spread is a partial reduction, not an increase in spreading; (3) that standards were deliberately lowered so 'no matter how bad the vaccine is, it's going to pass'; (4) that unblinding and crossover was done to conceal long-term harms, 'covering your future tracks' — crossover was an ethics-committee requirement once efficacy was demonstrated, since withholding an effective vaccine from the placebo arm is not permissible. Also misattributes Peter Doshi as 'the editor of the BMJ' (he is an associate editor). The regulatory-capture material (PDUFA user fees, NIH patent royalties, 1997 DTC advertising rule) is largely factual but is deployed to support the false conclusions above.

Myocarditis was publicly communicated via CDC ACIP on 23 June 2021 and an FDA fact-sheet warning the same month. Data-mining signal detection generates hypotheses requiring adjudication, not confirmed harms, so an unadjudicated signal list is not evidence of concealment. GOOD TEST CASE for web fallback.

Stance is mixed and sarcastic; the speaker's position is that harm occurred. Hard case — a stance classifier reading only the first sentence will call this debunking.

title: The Truth About Excess Deaths Since COVID Vaxx Is Mind-Blowing!  w/ Dr. John Campbell
flagged_phrase: it is surprising that the way that data was collected changed and the amount of data released was reduced. And it's often difficult to get information even on freedom of information requests. You know, it's almost as if people had something to hide
supporting_evidence: NO CORPUS COVERAGE of mortality surveillance. External: excess mortality in 2021-22 is real and is attributed principally to COVID-19 deaths themselves plus indirect effects — delayed care, disrupted screening, cardiovascular deaths from untreated conditions (ONS and OECD analyses). The UK Office for Health Improvement and Disparities was reorganised in 2023 under a machinery-of-government change, and excess-mortality data continues to be published by ONS, so the cessation claim is inaccurate. Studies comparing vaccinated and unvaccinated cohorts find LOWER non-COVID mortality in the vaccinated (Xu et al. 2023, JAMA Netw Open). Nearest corpus support: no excess-mortality signal in ~5.1M people (IN CORPUS: vaccines-11-01118.pdf).
annotator_note: DELIBERATE EDGE CASE. Jimmy Dore with Dr John Campbell on post-rollout excess mortality. Campbell is careful: he explains the excess-death baseline method correctly, and when asked directly whether this shows deaths attributable to vaccines he answers 'No, but there are plausible mechanisms'. That hedge alone would not flag. What tips it to true is the asserted factual claim of DATA SUPPRESSION — that the UK stopped publishing, changed collection methods, and withholds FOI responses, 'almost as if people had something to hide'. Dore's framing question ('what are the studies that prove people are dying at higher rates') presupposes proof that Campbell then declines to supply. Confidence medium: a reviewer could reasonably label this false on the grounds that Campbell explicitly refuses the causal claim and the suppression allegation is hedged with 'almost as if'. FLAGGED FOR YOUR REVIEW alongside F-LD9pvPXQE.

annotator_note: RFK Jr. on The Young Turks. UNUSUALLY WELL-ARGUED and partly accurate: vaccine-injury compensation payouts are real; the 1986 liability shield is real; Vioxx and the $79bn in pharma criminal penalties are real; 'no vaccine is safe and effective for everyone' and the Supreme Court's 'unavoidably unsafe' language are correctly cited. And they knew it wasn't true at the time' — asserting deliberate deception rather than evolving evidence and overstatement; (2) the implication that because transmission claims were overstated, the vaccines do not reduce transmission at all; (3) '72 vaccines now mandated for our children' (inflated; the childhood schedule covers ~16 diseases, with doses counted separately and mandates set by states). Confidence medium — this is the most defensible of the flagged videos and the one where a reviewer most plausibly disagrees. FLAGGED FOR YOUR REVIEW.

title: The COVID Vaccine DNA Bombshell They Tried to Hide | Exclusive with Dr. David Speicher
flagged_phrase: it's been known since 1999 if you take a DNA fragment attached to a SV40 enhancer, insert it into a cell such as in a lipid nanoparticle, it will enter the cell's nucleus and into the genome of that cell ... there is a spike made up to 704 days post-vax
supporting_evidence: Residual DNA fragments are present at trace levels within regulatory limits and are short, non-replicating and non-integrating; the SV40 sequence present is a short promoter/enhancer element, not the SV40 virus or an integration system, and carries no capacity to drive genomic insertion. Integration would additionally require reverse transcriptase and integrase, which are absent (IN CORPUS: cdc_108736_DS1.pdf addresses DNA alteration directly). No peer-reviewed study has demonstrated vaccine-derived genomic integration in humans. The 704-day spike-persistence claim derives from a small preliminary Yale post-vaccination-syndrome study, is not peer-reviewed as a causal finding, and conflicts with studies showing mRNA degradation within days and spike clearance within weeks. Spike protein is not an established toxin at vaccine-derived quantities. PubPeer and Retraction Watch are post-publication-review platforms with no demonstrated pharma funding. Already in chunk_eval_labels.
annotator_note: Redacted with Dr David Speicher on residual plasmid DNA in mRNA vaccines. The TRUE kernel: trace residual DNA from the plasmid template is a real manufacturing consideration and is measured and limited by regulators. The ASSERTED FALSEHOODS built on it: (1) that the DNA enters the nucleus and integrates into the human genome via an SV40 promoter element — stated as near-established ('it will enter the cell's nucleus and into the genome of that cell'); (2) that Pfizer 'intentionally used a gene therapy plasmid'; (3) that spike protein is produced for up to 704 days post-vaccination and is 'toxic'; (4) that the shots 'are effective at causing harm'; (5) that PubPeer and Retraction Watch are 'funded by pharma investors paying people to rip apart' dissenting papers. Transcript is garbled in places (ASR errors: 'bears' for VAERS, 'non-biolactiv', 'bait and itch'). Contains a mid-interview skincare advertisement.

supporting_evidence: Spike protein studied at high doses in animal models in isolation is not equivalent to the transient, localised quantities produced after vaccination, where mRNA is degraded within days and spike cleared within weeks; 'irrefutably toxic' is not an established characterisation at vaccine-derived exposures. Transient reductions in aerobic capacity after any immune activation (including infection and other vaccines) are expected and recover; an 8.6% VO2 drop in a minority of athletes is not permanent lung damage, and pulmonary hypertension is not an established vaccine sequela. Vaccine-associated myocarditis is real, rare and usually resolves (IN CORPUS: clc-45-691.pdf; clinpract-16-00077.pdf; vaccines-10-01316.pdf); no persistent-impairment signal in ~5.1M people (IN CORPUS: vaccines-11-01118.pdf). The cited VO2 study figures are relayed roughly accurately (19% of athletes with an 8.6% drop, remainder averaging 2.7%, mean age 37), and Sullivan's own illness is his personal account. It is toxic, irrefutably so' — asserted as settled; (2) escalation of a modest, transient VO2 finding into 'very long and, in some cases, permanent lung damage for a lot of people'; (3) the framing 'I told you guys that all this was going to happen ... this is me being vindicated'; (4) attributing the paediatric recommendation to 'follow the money'. Note the host explicitly pre-empts criticism of the witness's credentials, and much of the segment is opinion about policy. Confidence medium: the underlying study exists and the host does cite numbers. FLAGGED FOR YOUR REVIEW.

title: Dr. Peter McCullough on the Most Serious Side Effects of the Covid-19 Vaccine
flagged_phrase: So the true number of vaccine deaths is between 500 and 600,000 deaths ... These are deaths reported to VAERS by doctors like me who've already determined the vaccine is the cause of death. This is not controversial
supporting_evidence: VAERS is a passive, open-submission system: a report records a temporal association claimed by the submitter, not an adjudicated cause of death, and CDC/FDA review death reports including death certificates, autopsy and medical records — a review that has not established a causal link for the large majority (the 'zero investigated' claim is false). The Lazarus (Harvard Pilgrim) under-reporting estimate concerned non-serious events in routine outpatient settings and cannot be applied as a multiplier to death reports during the most intensively surveilled vaccination campaign in history; multiplying unadjudicated reports by an under-reporting factor compounds two errors. Population-level all-cause mortality studies find vaccinated cohorts with LOWER non-COVID mortality than unvaccinated (Xu et al. 2023, JAMA Netw Open), and a 500,000-death signal would be unmissable in national vital statistics. Myocarditis after mRNA vaccination is real, rare, concentrated in young males and usually self-limiting (IN CORPUS: clc-45-691.pdf; clinpract-16-00077.pdf; vaccines-10-01316.pdf; cureus-0017-00000098208.pdf); no excess mortality signal in ~5.1M people (IN CORPUS: vaccines-11-01118.pdf).
annotator_note: Theo Von with Dr Peter McCullough. The central assertion: 16,609/19,609 VAERS death reports multiplied by a claimed 30-fold under-reporting factor to conclude 'the true number of vaccine deaths is between 500 and 600,000'. Also asserts: VAERS death reports are determinations of causation ('these are deaths reported to VAERS by doctors like me who've already determined the vaccine is the cause of death ... this is not up to the CDC to decide'); that CDC has investigated 'zero' of them; that the vaccine-death pattern is 'during sports and athletics and then dead in bed'; that only mortality above ~15% of the population would be visible, so absence of visible deaths is not evidence. NOTE several cited papers are real and correctly characterised: Krauson 2023 (mRNA detected in myocardium in a subset dying within 30 days), Baumeier (spike protein in heart tissue), Verma 2021 NEJM (one fatal Moderna myocarditis case), Gill 2022 Arch Pathol (two adolescent deaths post-dose-2). Fatal vaccine-associated myocarditis does occur and is documented — the falsehood is the 500,000-600,000 extrapolation and the claim that VAERS entries constitute adjudicated causation.

title: FDA approves new mRNA vaccine, despite risks.
flagged_phrase: Let me quickly tell you what it's about ... will I be taking this vaccine? Let me think. No ... Right, let's get straight onto the business of this unfortunate development
supporting_evidence: See 8a-MTuhfw98. Grade 3 solicited reactogenicity is transient and categorically different from serious harm; higher reactogenicity with mRNA platforms versus inactivated comparators is expected from stronger immune activation and is documented (IN CORPUS: vaccines-09-00467-v2.pdf; vaccines-09-00989-v2.pdf; vaccines-11-01118.pdf). The trial endpoint was non-inferiority and superiority against an active comparator, so absolute risk reduction versus placebo is not the relevant measure.
annotator_note: Dr John Campbell on the FDA approval of Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine (mFluSav). Companion to 8a-MTuhfw98 and largely the same argument and the same error: juxtaposing solicited reactogenicity rates against absolute risk reduction to conclude net harm, and treating the vaccine's approval as 'this unfortunate development' decided in advance ('will I be taking this vaccine? No'). Also impugns the New England Journal publication with 'sure, there's no conflict of interest at all in that publication'. Confidence medium for the same reason as its companion: figures are sourced to the paper and FDA documents, and he frames it as personal choice. See 8a-MTuhfw98 for the full reasoning. FLAGGED FOR YOUR REVIEW.

supporting_evidence: The Fraiman et al. (2022, Vaccine) ~1-per-800 figure used a composite endpoint of adverse events of special interest including events with no established causal link, and its authors did not conclude net harm; it is not comparable to the confirmed, specific causal syndromes that triggered the swine-flu (Guillain-Barre) and RotaShield (intussusception) withdrawals. Subsequent large linked-record studies found no such rate (IN CORPUS: vaccines-11-01118.pdf ~5.1M people; vaccines-09-00467-v2.pdf RCT meta-analysis). Myocarditis was publicly communicated by CDC ACIP on 23 June 2021 with an FDA fact-sheet warning the same month. Signal-detection outputs are hypotheses requiring adjudication, not concealed confirmed harms. GOOD TEST CASE for web fallback.
annotator_note: Jimmy Dore with Senator Ron Johnson (8,359 words). Asserts: (1) 'the COVID vaccines are toxic and they cause way amount of adverse events, more than any other vaccine'; (2) a serious adverse event rate of one per 800 (the Fraiman reanalysis figure) presented alongside the 1976 swine flu (1 per 100,000) and 1999 RotaShield (1-2 per 10,000) withdrawals to argue the COVID vaccines should likewise have been withdrawn; (3) that Biden health officials 'purposely turned a blind eye' and used 'masking' to conceal safety signals; (4) 'the greatest government scandal in my lifetime' with deaths and disabilities concealed. title: The Hidden Truth About COVID Vaccines 2025 10 14
flagged_phrase: Psychosis is 440 times more likely. Schizophrenia is 315 times more likely. Dementia is 140 times more likely.
supporting_evidence: NO DIRECT CORPUS COVERAGE of neuropsychiatric outcomes — a genuine gap. External support: the Global Vaccine Data Network study of 99 million vaccinated people across eight countries examined 13 adverse events of special interest and found no neuropsychiatric signal of any such magnitude (Faksova et al. 2024, Vaccine, doi:10.1016/j.vaccine.2024.01.100). VAERS disproportionality ratios are not relative risks and cannot be read as 'times more likely' — the system accepts unverified public reports. Nearest corpus support: the 5.1M-person real-world safety study found no disproportionate serious-event signal (IN CORPUS: vaccines-11-01118.pdf). GOOD TEST CASE for the web-search fallback.
annotator_note: MOST SEVERE SO FAR. Asserts fabricated relative risks — psychosis 440x, schizophrenia 315x, dementia 140x — attributed to FDA/CDC safety thresholds being 'breached massively'. annotator_note: THE MOST IMPORTANT HARD NEGATIVE IN THE DATASET. An official US FDA presentation (June 2025 safety label change) titled 'mRNA COVID Shots Cause Myocarditis'. title: Looking into adverse effects of the COVID-19 vaccine
annotator_note: OUTSTANDING HARD NEGATIVE — the best VAERS debunking in the dataset. KTVB walks through exactly why raw VAERS data cannot support causal claims: anyone can post (the 'third arm has grown out of my forehead' report, the 2004 'incredible Hulk' report), reports are voluntary and biased, and CDC's own language is quoted verbatim. Then supplies the real numbers in context: 38 confirmed clots per 12.6M J&J doses (0.003%), 5,946 death reports per 331M doses with no established causal link, benchmarked against falls, car crashes, choking and gunshots. Also refutes the Nuremberg-code argument correctly (Houston Methodist ruling, at-will employment). Densely packed with every term a flagging system keys on — VAERS, blood clots, deaths, Nuremberg, Nazi doctors — while being rigorous. Compare against P0lymSkLbTs and Fu8lEbQXSKM, which use similar material to the opposite end. Already in chunk_eval_labels as blood_clots.

title: Wellstar COVID Myth Busters: The Vaccine Contains a Microchip
annotator_note: Denies microchips. Says 'antibiotic response' where it means antibody — a misstatement, not misinformation.

title: The Truth About My Anti-Vax Debate
annotator_note: EXEMPLARY HARD NEGATIVE. Doctor Mike reflecting on his Jubilee debate with 17 vaccine skeptics. Quotes skeptic anecdotes verbatim and at length (child with hydrocephalus after vaccination, Bell's palsy after flu vaccine, 'they're dying from the vaccine side effects') — then explains precisely why they do not establish causation: correlation versus causation, natural background incidence, and the key point that VAERS is an open passive system with unverified, possibly duplicate or falsified reports, versus CDC death-certificate verification for COVID deaths. Concedes that serious vaccine side effects do happen and that warnings have been issued before. This is the clearest statement of the correct VAERS reasoning in the dataset, embedded in dense misinformation vocabulary — pair with mkZ1MabMEZw and cGF0D2poGyA.

annotator_note: SciShow on mRNA platform applications beyond COVID — flu, cancer. Accurate mechanism (lipid nanoparticles solving stability and delivery, mRNA degraded within hours, no viral material delivered). Positive framing throughout; no false claims. Contains a Brilliant sponsorship read.

annotator_note: CBS Evening News. Frames the claim as misinformation, cites a fertility doctor stating no evidence. Voices a hesitant patient's fears verbatim ('Will it cause females to be sterile?') — those are quoted concerns, not the report's assertions. High false-positive risk from quoted fear language. title: Covid Vaccine Study Finds Links to Health Conditions
annotator_note: HARD NEGATIVE. Bloomberg TV interview on the same GVDN study as ZfPpHkXSTPk. Explicitly frames the findings as reassuring and notes POTS occurs MORE often after infection than vaccination. Every adverse event named (myocarditis, pericarditis, CVST, Guillain-Barre) is real and correctly attributed to vaccine type. Must not be flagged.

title: COVID Vaccine Conspiracy: Microchips, Wheelchairs, and Heart Attacks #shorts
annotator_note: Hosts raise the microchip claim as a 'funny conspiracy theory that might actually be true' — hedged speculation, not assertion — then relay an unverifiable anecdote about a child disabled after vaccination. Under the annotation rules: 'possibly' is not asserting, and an anecdotal causal attribution is a personal account rather than a factual claim. Nothing checkable is asserted as fact, so false. HARD NEGATIVE: contains the strongest myth vocabulary in the short set (microchip, wheelchair, heart attacks, seizures) while not asserting anything.

title: Latest research on vaccine side effects, immune reaction and thrombosis risks | COVID-19 Special
annotator_note: EXCELLENT HARD NEGATIVE. DW News COVID-19 Special on AstraZeneca/J&J thrombosis. Reports the real TTS numbers precisely — 20 million AZ doses by end of March, 79 thrombosis cases, 19 FATAL — plus the J&J pause after six cases in six million. Every alarming fact is true and sourced to MHRA and EMA. Contextualises correctly: EMA states benefits far outweigh risks; the Oxford report showing infection carries higher clot risk; mRNA platforms showed no equivalent signal across 100M+ US doses. The expert explicitly declines to overclaim ('we need to gather that information'), and the sex-difference discussion is appropriately hedged. Densest concentration of fatal-outcome vocabulary in the dataset while being model science journalism. Already a pipeline regression case and in chunk_eval_labels as blood_clots.

title: Can the COVID-19 Vaccine Make You Infertile?
annotator_note: The Doctors with Dr Paul Offit. Exemplary debunking of both the syncytin-1 infertility claim (the 'identical social security number because both contain a five' analogy; 36 trial pregnancies split 18/18) and the DNA-alteration claim (no nuclear access signal, no reverse transcriptase, no integrase). States the chance is 'not small, zero'. Dense with myth vocabulary (magnetic, altering DNA, infertile) while being rigorous.

title: UM Research Debunks Nicki Minaj COVID Vaccine Infertility Conspiracy Theories
annotator_note: Byte-identical transcript to gQfeAj5w-yc (same CBS package, two channels). Keep one for eval to avoid double-counting.

title: COVID VACCINE - Does it cause INFERTILITY?
annotator_note: EXCELLENT HARD NEGATIVE. Dr Christy Risinger dispels both the genome-alteration and syncytin-1 infertility myths. States each myth at length before refuting it, and the refutation is unusually rigorous: mRNA never enters the nucleus; ~10% of the human genome is endogenous retroviral DNA (so genome integration by viruses already happens, just not via vaccines); syncytin-1 and SARS-CoV-2 spike are both fusion proteins but from different virus groups, different shapes, and syncytin-1 is less than half the size. Explicitly acknowledges 'myths that gain traction always have a hint of truth'. Discloses absence of financial ties. Already in chunk_eval_labels.

title: #ListenToTheExperts - Is there a microchip in the vaccine? Prof Barry Schoub
annotator_note: Expert flatly denies microchip. Debunking.

title: Side Effects Of The Pfizer Vaccine For COVID-19 Explained
annotator_note: Health Digest side-effect explainer. Accurate: CDC figures, 95% efficacy, allergic-reaction signs, 15-minute observation, and the CDC's own myocarditis/pericarditis statement quoted correctly. Notes long-term effects are 'highly unlikely' per experts — appropriately hedged. Accurate consumer health content.

title: Scientists Are Developing Injectable Microchips... But Not For Vaccines | TechnoLogic
annotator_note: CRITICAL HARD NEGATIVE — the most adversarial in the dataset for a keyword system. Motherboard/VICE on a REAL injectable microchip (Columbia, grain-of-salt size, ultrasound-powered) whose announcement was seized on by vaccine-microchip conspiracists. The video's thesis is explicitly that the chip has NOTHING to do with vaccines: predates COVID by years, tested in raw chicken and one mouse, never in a human, communicates by ultrasound not RF so 5G interfacing is physically impossible. Also debunks the Event 201 'dry run' claim and quotes conspiracy audio clips verbatim ('interface with all of the 5G towers', 'mark of the beast') in order to refute them. Contains every trigger term — injectable microchip, 5G, tracking, mark of the beast, Event 201 — while being rigorous science journalism that affirms 'the mRNA vaccines have worked spectacularly well'. Pair with ajc_ip-IbdQ (real Swedish implant) as the two true-premise microchip negatives.

title: Covid Vaccine Side Effects + VAERS
annotator_note: EXCELLENT HARD NEGATIVE. Dialogue format voicing the VAERS myth ('millions of side effects', 'thousands died') and then refuting it with correct base-rate reasoning: 55,000 Americans die weekly from all causes, so deaths within 7 days of vaccination are expected regardless. Densely packed with the exact phrases a flagging system keys on, while being rigorous debunking. Compare directly with P0lymSkLbTs, which makes the OPPOSITE error with similar vocabulary.

title: Second COVID Vaccine Shot Side Effects
annotator_note: SciShow, Feb 2021. Accurate innate-vs-adaptive explanation of why dose 2 reactions are stronger. Model epistemic practice: states its filming date up front, cites trial reactogenicity correctly, benchmarks against Shingrix, and when discussing the one-dose-after-infection hypothesis explicitly labels the two supporting studies as preprints with a few hundred participants, not peer-reviewed, and says 'we can't start making sweeping statements yet' and 'there are no changes in policy'. Discusses natural immunity favourably (10x antibodies after one dose in the previously infected) without drawing the unsupported conclusion that infection is preferable — contrast with 2MrNkagJIwY, which does.

title: RNA Vaccines (mRNA Vaccine) - Basis of Pfizer and Moderna COVID-19 vaccines, Animation
annotator_note: Technical animation on RNA vaccine mechanism. Accurate, including that mRNA does not enter the nucleus so genome integration is unlikely, and that RNA is degraded after translation. Also states real disadvantages (cold chain, delivery challenges). Balanced and correct.

title: COVID-19 Vaccine FAQs: Microchip... a third limb... Are the vaccine myths true?
annotator_note: Clinician refutes microchip (needle-gauge argument), birth defects and infertility. 'Perfectly safe' is slightly strong but within normal clinical register. Debunking.

title: Tony Jimenez and Ty Bollinger: Scrambled Science
annotator_note: OFF-NARRATIVE. Sholto David (research-integrity sleuth) debunking Ty Bollinger and Tony Jimenez on the 'sugar feeds cancer' claim, with a correct stereochemistry explanation of D/L and R/S nomenclature. Not about COVID vaccines at all — captured by the collection query presumably via the channel's other content. Label false (it is rigorous debunking), but recommend EXCLUDING from evaluation as out of scope, alongside RnWIrve2yv0.

title: Does the Covid Vaccine Cause Heart Attacks in Young People? | Truth Explained!
annotator_note: TEASER ONLY — poses whether a real cluster of young heart attacks in Karnataka is vaccine-related, lists many candidate causes, and defers all answers to 'my detailed video'. Asserts no causal claim. Label false because nothing false is asserted, but the content that would decide it is absent. Consider excluding from eval as unlabellable.

title: What Are Long-Term Effects of the COVID Vaccine? A Doctor Explains
annotator_note: Dr Jen Caudle on long-term effects, sourced to Children's Hospital of Philadelphia. Accurate: vaccine adverse effects historically manifest within ~2 months, which is the basis of the FDA's minimum follow-up requirement, and participants continue to be tracked after that. Repeatedly hedges rather than overclaims ('I can't promise anything because who can promise anything in medicine and science', 'we never say never'). Redirects the long-term-effects worry to long COVID with a patient example. Note this is the same channel as QJ5k7AIiST8 — two separate videos, both accurate.

title: Could the COVID-19 vaccine cause infertility? | Verify
annotator_note: KCEN Verify segment. Traces the infertility claim to Michael Yeadon's EMA petition, notes it used conditional phrasing ('if the vaccine works a certain way, it could'), and refutes via the syncytin-1 amino-acid-sequence argument. Explicitly concedes long-term fertility data did not yet exist — honest hedging, not a claim. Debunking.

title: 4. COVID-19 Vaccines and Side Effects for Women (Updated)
annotator_note: Accurate: side effects real and mild, women report more, cites 35,000-pregnancy study. Debunking.

title: The Truth About COVID-19 Vaccines ft. Dr. Seema Yasmin
annotator_note: Doctor Mike with Dr Seema Yasmin (Stanford), Dec 2020. Accurate contemporaneous FAQ: two-dose schedules and intervals, no mixing data at the time, immunity developing 1-2 weeks after dose 2, honest about side effects requiring a day off work. Correctly contextualises allergic reactions (single-digit cases per several million doses, all treated successfully) and the 15-minute observation rationale. Also notes a real pharmacist dosing error without sensationalising it. Accurate for its date.

title: mRNA Vaccine Safety - Micheal Fletcher, MD
annotator_note: Physician reassurance on mRNA safety, cites the 43,000-dose Pfizer trial. 'Every reason to believe no long-term side effects' is a forward-looking claim but was reasonable at the time and is hedged ('obviously we don't know'). Accurate that the vaccine cannot give you COVID-19.

title: COVID Vaccine SIDE EFFECTS are Finally Kicking in... People are having Serious Regrets!
annotator_note: TyBuggy Podcast. Despite the title ('SIDE EFFECTS are Finally Kicking in... People are having Serious Regrets!'), the content is largely a MEDIA-LITERACY analysis comparing how CNN, NPR and Fox News framed Fauci pleading the Fifth, noting Fox's omission of context about the subpoena. The host explicitly disclaims ('this is for entertainment purposes only and everything you're about to see is alleged'). He asserts 'this exposes the American government' — rhetorical framing rather than a specific checkable vaccine claim — and does not make a false factual claim about the vaccine itself. Label false. Confidence medium: the title promises vaccine-harm content the transcript does not deliver, and a reviewer reading the title alone would expect true. FLAGGED FOR YOUR REVIEW.

title: VERIFY: Are there RFID chips in vaccines?
annotator_note: VERIFY segment on the $138M DOD syringe contract. Establishes the real nugget (RFID tags on the syringe LABEL, outside, not injected) and refutes the claim. Debunking with a true-premise nuance.

title: mRNA vaccines much safer than getting COVID-19: review
annotator_note: CBC report on a Lancet review of mRNA vaccines through Dec 2025. Core finding correctly stated: vaccine much safer than infection; heart inflammation is a rare side effect but COVID carries higher risk of the same. Accurate. NOTE: the line 'mRNA vaccines don't perform well' appears to be a transcription artifact mid-sentence and contradicts the surrounding text — likely garbled speech, not a claim.

annotator_note: Reports a study finding no sperm-quality decrease. Accurate; n=11 is small but reported as such.

title: How do the Covid vaccines affect male fertility?
annotator_note: Accurate and nuanced: vaccine-induced fever can transiently lower sperm count, COVID disease worse. Concedes a real minor effect while refuting the myth — must NOT be flagged.
